plan.source: Dushnikh Yal kept as the source of layout and rooms: main quest 4 needs the longhouse with its room and cellar, which only it holds; Ree-An-Wo (the closest Argonian camp) is Xanmeer ruins, scaffolds and six hide tents with no room, and the Loreisian camp is a shrine ring with no building. So Dushnikh Yal gives the longhouse, rooms and fire, and every orc piece is replaced from Ree-An-Wo or dropped
